stem: Which graph best represents a system of equations that has no solution?

options.label: A
options.text: (Graph with two intersecting lines, one steep and the other moderate slope, crossing at one point in the coordinate plane)

options.label: B
options.text: (Graph with two parallel lines with different slopes, one decreasing and one increasing)

options.label: C
options.text: (Graph with two lines intersecting at one point, one line descending from left to right, the other ascending)

options.label: D
options.text: (Graph with two lines parallel, both ascending at same slope but different y-intercepts)

visual_elements: Graph B: parallel lines with different slopes
Graph D: parallel lines with same slope
notes: Option B shows lines with different slopes that are not equal, so they are not parallel hence they intersect; option A and C show intersecting lines; option D shows parallel lines with same slope but different intercepts, indicating no solution.
